# Invio (Invio Invoice)

> Invio Invoice is free invoice software and offline billing software for Windows, Mac, and Linux. Made by Timrio for shops, small businesses, cafes, and freelancers.

Invio Invoice helps you create GST and regular bills in seconds, print paper receipts with UPI QR codes, scan product barcodes, track your shop stock, and keep every customer record safely on your own computer — with no internet needed.

- **Where Data Is Saved**: 100% on your own computer (no cloud needed, works offline).
- **Works On**: Windows 10/11, Mac (Apple Silicon & Intel), and Linux.

## What You Can Do With Invio
- **Fast GST & Normal Bills**: Automatic GST tax calculation (local and out-of-state), discounts, and neat A4/A5 PDF bills.
- **Paper Receipt Printing**: Works with small 2-inch (58mm) and 3-inch (80mm) shop receipt printers as well as regular office printers.
- **UPI QR Code on Bills**: Prints a scan-and-pay UPI QR code for the exact bill amount so customers can pay with Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or BHIM.
- **Official Add-ons**: Picture-tile POS checkout (Free), Customer POS Display second screen (Free), Restaurant Table QR ordering & Kitchen Screen (Plus), Email PDF bills (Plus), and WhatsApp sharing (Plus).
- **Barcode Scanner Ready**: Plug in any USB or wireless barcode gun and scan items straight into the bill.
- **Stock & Inventory Tracking**: Stock goes down automatically when you sell, comes back if you cancel a bill, and warns you when items are running low.
- **Customer Diary (Udhar / Credit)**: Save customer phone numbers, track unpaid dues, and record partial payments.

- [Income Tax Calculator (India)](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/income-tax-india): Compare New vs Old Tax Regime for FY 2025–26.
- [UK VAT Calculator](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/vat-uk): Calculate 20%, 5%, and 0% UK VAT.
- [UAE VAT Calculator](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/vat-uae): Calculate 5% UAE VAT.
- [Free Payslip Generator](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/payslip-generator): Create and print monthly employee salary slips.
- [Paycheck Calculator](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/paycheck-calc): Calculate take-home salary after deductions.
- [HRA Exemption Calculator](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/hra-exemption): Calculate House Rent Allowance tax savings.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/gratuity-calc): Calculate employee gratuity payout.
- [Project Cost Estimate Calculator](https://invio.timrio.com/tools/project-estimate): Estimate project quotes, hours, and costs.
